name: Lothric
tagline: A dying kingdom, where the First Flame waits to be linked.
story: For ages the First Flame has kept the Age of Fire alive, and every time it began to fade a great soul offered itself as fuel to link the flame. Those who did so became Lords of Cinder.

Now the flame is fading again, and the bell has tolled to summon the Lords back to their thrones in Firelink Shrine. But they have refused. Most have abandoned their duty, and Prince Lothric, raised to link the flame, has turned his back on it. The land is crumbling into ash, and the undead curse spreads.

You are one of the Unkindled, an undead who failed to become a Lord in life, now risen from the grave when the bell tolled. Your task is to find the Lords of Cinder, return them to their thrones, and decide whether to link the fire or let it die.

characters.name: Knight
characters.backstory: A wandering knight in full armour, with a sturdy shield and a longsword. Well balanced and hard to put down.
characters.trait: Steadfast: cannot be staggered by the first heavy blow in a fight.

characters.name: Herald
characters.backstory: A spear-carrying preacher who spreads a faith few still believe in. Carries a shield and knows healing miracles.
characters.trait: Heal Aid: once per fight, restore a small amount of HP.

characters.name: Sorcerer
characters.backstory: A sorcerer from the Grand Archives' tradition of soul sorceries, fragile but able to strike from afar with soul arrows.
characters.trait: Soul Arrow: MAG attacks hit before melee in a tied round.

characters.name: Pyromancer
characters.backstory: A pyromancer from the Great Swamp, carrying a hand axe and a pyromancy flame. Fights well both up close and with fire.
characters.trait: Fireball: once per fight, a MAG attack deals extra fire damage.

bosses.name: Iudex Gundyr
bosses.title: Judge of the Unkindled
bosses.lore: An armoured giant, pinned in place by a coiled sword in the Cemetery of Ash, who tests every Unkindled before they may reach Firelink Shrine. Mid-fight, a dark, writhing mass bursts from his body and he becomes something far less human.

bosses.name: Vordt of the Boreal Valley
bosses.title: Outrider Knight of Irithyll
bosses.lore: One of the Pontiff's Outrider Knights, guarding the gate of the High Wall of Lothric. He fights on all fours like a beast, swinging a great mace and breathing frost.

bosses.name: Dancer of the Boreal Valley
bosses.title: Outrider Knight of the royal blood
bosses.lore: A tall, thin knight who rises from the floor of the High Wall's chapel and fights with two curved swords, one of them burning with dark fire. Her movements are slow and graceful until they suddenly are not.

bosses.name: Dragonslayer Armour
bosses.title: Guardian of the Grand Archives Bridge
bosses.lore: An empty suit of armour animated by the will of the Pilgrim Butterflies, guarding the bridge to Lothric Castle and the Grand Archives. It wields a lightning-charged greataxe and a great shield.

npcs.name: The Fire Keeper
npcs.quote: A quiet, masked woman who tends the shrine's bonfire and turns souls into strength for the Unkindled.

npcs.name: Andre of Astora
npcs.quote: A cheerful old blacksmith who reinforces weapons and reminds you to take care of them.

npcs.name: Ludleth of Courland
npcs.quote: The smallest Lord of Cinder, and the only one who stayed. He can transpose boss souls into weapons and spells.

npcs.name: Yuria of Londor
npcs.where: Firelink Shrine, after a certain quest begins
npcs.quote: A masked woman from Londor, a land of Hollows. She hints that the Unkindled could choose a different fate than linking the fire.
